# USCM Hazardous Operations Unit
## Under Construction This page is still being written. Until then, here is the unit's lore primer.
[italic]The United States Colonial Marines Hazardous Operations Unit (HAZOPS) specializes in high-risk environments, including chemical, biological, radiological, and explosive threats. HAZOPS teams are trained for rapid response and containment in CBRN conditions.[/italic]
